requirements.text: Receptionists must be able to see, for any patient, whether the patient has a portal account and whether it is locked.
requirements.quote: Receptionists shall be able to see, for any patient, whether the patient has a portal account and whether it is locked, so that they can direct the patient appropriately.

requirements.text: The portal must not keep its own copy of the appointment book; every availability search and booking must be made against the PMS.
requirements.quote: The portal shall not keep its own copy of the appointment book; every availability search and booking shall be made against the PMS.

requirements.text: Each site may choose which of its appointment types are offered online.
requirements.quote: Each site may choose which of its appointment types are offered online.

requirements.text: Urgent and same-day appointments remain telephone-only in the first release. Urgent and same-day appointments are telephone-only because the clinics triage those calls clinically.
requirements.quote: Urgent and same-day appointments remain telephone-only in the first release because the clinics triage those calls clinically.

requirements.text: The portal will not offer a symptom checker or any form of clinical advice.
requirements.quote: The portal will not offer a symptom checker or any form of clinical advice.

requirements.text: Patients must already be registered at one of the six clinics to use the portal.
requirements.quote: Patients must already be registered at one of the six clinics to use the portal.

requirements.text: A registered patient can create a portal account by verifying identity against PMS details using date of birth, surname, postcode and a one-time code sent to the mobile number held in the PMS.
requirements.quote: A registered patient shall be able to create a portal account by verifying their identity against the details held in the PMS, using their date of birth, surname, postcode and a one-time code sent to the mobile number held in the PMS.

requirements.text: If a patient has no mobile number in the PMS, the portal tells them to contact their clinic and offers no other online identity verification.
requirements.quote: the portal shall tell the patient to contact their clinic and shall not offer any other way to verify their identity online.

requirements.text: Patients sign in with an email address and password, and the portal requires a second factor on every sign-in from a device it has not seen before.
requirements.quote: A patient shall sign in with an email address and password, and the portal shall require a second factor on every sign-in from a device it has not seen before.

requirements.text: The portal locks an account after five consecutive failed sign-in attempts and unlocks it automatically after thirty minutes.
requirements.quote: The portal shall lock an account after five consecutive failed sign-in attempts and shall unlock it automatically after thirty minutes.

requirements.text: Front-desk staff cannot unlock accounts manually in the first release. Manual unlocking was deliberately left out to avoid a social engineering route.
requirements.quote: Front-desk staff will not be able to unlock accounts manually in the first release; this was discussed and deliberately left out to avoid creating a social engineering route.

requirements.text: A signed-in session ends after a period of inactivity, and the patient is warned before it ends.
requirements.quote: A signed-in session shall end after a period of inactivity, and the patient shall be warned before it ends.

requirements.text: A carer can book, reschedule and cancel appointments for any dependant linked to their account.
requirements.quote: A carer shall be able to book, reschedule and cancel appointments for any dependant linked to their account.

requirements.text: A carer-dependant link is created only by front-desk staff after checking the carer's authority, and patients cannot create links themselves.
requirements.quote: A link between a carer and a dependant shall only be created by front-desk staff after they have checked the carer's authority, and the portal shall not let a patient create such a link themselves.

requirements.text: A carer link for a dependant under sixteen ends automatically on their sixteenth birthday, and the portal notifies the carer thirty days beforehand.
requirements.quote: A carer link for a dependant under the age of sixteen shall end automatically on the dependant's sixteenth birthday, and the portal shall notify the carer thirty days beforehand.

requirements.text: Links for adult dependants are reviewed periodically.
requirements.quote: Links for adult dependants, for example a patient with a lasting power of attorney in place, are reviewed periodically.

requirements.text: The portal shows a patient only appointment types marked bookable online at the patient's registered site.
requirements.quote: The portal shall show a patient only the appointment types that are marked as bookable online at the patient's registered site.

requirements.text: For physiotherapy follow-ups and travel health consultations, the portal also offers slots at other sites delivering those services.
requirements.quote: For physiotherapy follow-ups and travel health consultations, the portal shall also offer slots at the other sites that deliver those services.

requirements.text: The portal shows availability for the next four weeks and lets the patient filter by site, clinician, day of week and time of day.
requirements.quote: The portal shall show availability for the next four weeks and shall let the patient filter by site, clinician, day of the week and time of day.

requirements.text: Availability shown in the portal reflects the PMS appointment book in near real time.
requirements.quote: Availability shown in the portal shall reflect the PMS appointment book in near real time.

requirements.text: When a patient selects a slot, the portal holds it for five minutes so no one else can book it, and releases it if not confirmed in that period.
requirements.quote: the portal shall place a hold on it for five minutes so that no other patient or staff member can book it while the patient completes the booking.

requirements.text: A patient may not hold more than two future routine GP appointments at once across all sites.
requirements.quote: A patient shall not hold more than two future routine GP appointments at the same time across all sites.

requirements.text: The two-appointment limit does not apply to nurse reviews, immunisations or physiotherapy.
requirements.quote: This limit does not apply to nurse reviews, immunisations or physiotherapy, which are often booked as a series.

requirements.text: The portal does not allow a booking that starts less than two hours from the current time.
requirements.quote: The portal shall not allow a booking that starts less than two hours from the current time.

requirements.text: Childhood immunisation appointments are bookable only by a carer for a dependant whose age is within the range set for that immunisation type in the PMS.
requirements.quote: Childhood immunisation appointments shall only be bookable by a carer for a dependant whose age is within the range set for that immunisation type in the PMS.

requirements.text: Before confirming, the portal asks for a free-text reason of up to 200 characters and passes it to the PMS with the booking.
requirements.quote: the portal shall ask the patient to state the reason for the appointment in a free-text field of up to 200 characters, which shall be passed to the PMS with the booking.

requirements.text: Patients are told the reason field is not monitored and urgent problems must be telephoned in.
requirements.quote: Patients will be told that the field is not monitored and that urgent problems must be telephoned in.

requirements.text: Every booking screen shows a clear warning not to use the portal for urgent medical problems, with the clinic telephone number and the national urgent care number.
requirements.quote: The portal shall show a clear warning on every booking screen that it must not be used for urgent medical problems, with the telephone number of the clinic and the national urgent care number.

requirements.text: The portal writes a confirmed booking to the PMS and shows confirmation only after the PMS has accepted it.
requirements.quote: the portal shall write it to the PMS and shall show the patient a confirmation only after the PMS has accepted it.

requirements.text: If the PMS is unavailable, the booking should be handled appropriately.
requirements.quote: If the PMS is unavailable, the booking should be handled appropriately.

requirements.text: A patient can cancel an appointment through the portal up to two hours before its start time.
requirements.quote: A patient shall be able to cancel an appointment through the portal up to two hours before its start time.

requirements.text: A patient can move an appointment to another slot of the same type, and the original slot is released only once the PMS accepts the new booking.
requirements.quote: A patient shall be able to move an appointment to another slot of the same appointment type, and the original slot shall only be released once the new booking has been accepted by the PMS.

requirements.text: The portal asks a cancelling patient to choose a reason from a list maintained by practice managers.
requirements.quote: The portal shall ask a patient who cancels to choose a reason from a list maintained by the practice managers.

requirements.text: Appointments booked by telephone are visible in the portal and cancellable by the patient in the same way as online bookings.
requirements.quote: Appointments booked by telephone shall be visible in the portal and shall be cancellable by the patient in the same way as appointments booked online.

requirements.text: The portal sends each patient a text reminder 48 hours before every appointment, whether booked online or by telephone.
requirements.quote: The portal shall send each patient a reminder by text message 48 hours before every appointment, whether it was booked online or by telephone.

requirements.text: A reminder lets the patient cancel by replying or following a link without signing in; cancelling this way releases the slot as in the portal.
requirements.quote: A reminder shall let the patient cancel the appointment by replying to the message or by following a link, without signing in.

requirements.text: The portal sends an email confirmation when an appointment is booked, moved or cancelled, to the email address of the account that made the change (the carer where a carer makes it).
requirements.quote: The portal shall send a confirmation by email when an appointment is booked, moved or cancelled, to the email address on the account that made the change.

requirements.text: Where a carer makes the change, the confirmation goes to the carer.
requirements.quote: Where a carer makes the change, the confirmation goes to the carer.

requirements.text: Patients can opt out of text reminders, and the choice is recorded in the PMS so it also applies to PMS reminders.
requirements.quote: Patients shall be able to choose not to receive text reminders, and the choice shall be recorded in the PMS so that it also applies to reminders the PMS sends.

requirements.text: A text reminder is sent 24 hours before the appointment to the patient, or the carer for a dependant.
requirements.quote: | Upcoming appointment | Text message | 24 hours before the appointment | The patient, or the carer for a dependant |

requirements.text: A same-day text reminder is sent at 7am to the patient for physiotherapy appointments starting after 10am.
requirements.quote: A same-day text reminder is sent at 7am for physiotherapy appointments starting after 10am.

requirements.text: A waiting list offer is sent by text and email to the waiting-list patient when a matching slot is released.
requirements.quote: | Waiting list offer | Text message and email | When a matching slot is released | The patient on the waiting list |

requirements.text: A patient who cannot find a suitable slot can join a waiting list for an appointment type and site, stating the days and times they could attend.
requirements.quote: A patient who cannot find a suitable slot shall be able to join a waiting list for a chosen appointment type and site, stating the days of the week and times of day they could attend.

requirements.text: When a matching slot is released at that site within the patient's stated availability, the portal offers it to waiting-list patients in the order they joined.
requirements.quote: the portal shall offer it to patients on the waiting list in the order in which they joined.

requirements.text: An offer expires if not accepted within a short period, and the slot is then offered to the next patient.
requirements.quote: An offer shall expire if it is not accepted within a short period, and the slot shall then be offered to the next patient on the list.

requirements.text: A patient is removed from a waiting list on accepting an offer, booking a matching appointment, or after 60 days, whichever is first.
requirements.quote: A patient shall be removed from a waiting list once they accept an offer, book a matching appointment themselves, or after 60 days, whichever comes first.

requirements.text: Practice managers can mark or unmark appointment types at their site as bookable online, taking effect in the portal within fifteen minutes.
requirements.quote: Practice managers shall be able to mark or unmark each appointment type at their own site as bookable online, and the change shall take effect in the portal within fifteen minutes.

requirements.text: Front-desk staff can see a list of the day's online bookings, cancellations and waiting list offers for their site, with each patient's reason for appointment.
requirements.quote: Front-desk staff shall be able to see a list of the day's online bookings, cancellations and waiting list offers for their site, with the reason for appointment given by each patient.

requirements.text: Front-desk staff can suspend online booking for a single clinician for a date range without changing the PMS rota. Unplanned leave is an example of when booking for a clinician would be suspended.
requirements.quote: Front-desk staff shall be able to suspend online booking for a single clinician for a date range, for example during unplanned leave, without changing the PMS rota.

requirements.text: The portal provides a monthly report per site showing online appointments booked, moved and cancelled, reminders sent, and missed appointments for online and telephone bookings separately.
requirements.quote: The portal shall provide a monthly report for each site showing the number of appointments booked, moved and cancelled online, the number of reminders sent, and the number of missed appointments for online and telephone bookings separately.

requirements.text: The portal must be available at least 99.5% of the time each calendar month, excluding planned maintenance announced at least five days ahead.
requirements.quote: The portal shall be available at least 99.5% of the time in each calendar month, excluding planned maintenance announced at least five days in advance.

requirements.text: Availability searches must return within three seconds for 95% of requests at peak load.
requirements.quote: Availability searches shall return results within three seconds for 95% of requests at peak load.

requirements.text: The patient-facing portal must meet WCAG 2.2 AA.
requirements.quote: The patient-facing portal shall meet the WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility standard.

requirements.text: The portal is available in English and, where possible, the other languages most commonly spoken by registered patients.
requirements.quote: The portal shall be available in English and in the other languages most commonly spoken by registered patients, where possible.

requirements.text: The portal stores only personal data needed for sign-in and reminders and reads all other patient details from the PMS when needed.
requirements.quote: The portal shall store only the personal data needed to sign patients in and to send reminders, and shall read all other patient details from the PMS when they are needed.

requirements.text: Every booking, change and cancellation is recorded in an audit log showing who made it, on whose behalf, and when.
requirements.quote: Every booking, change and cancellation made through the portal shall be recorded in an audit log showing who made it, on whose behalf, and when.

requirements.text: Audit log entries are kept for eight years and cannot be edited by any user, including system administrators.
requirements.quote: Audit log entries shall be kept for eight years and shall not be editable by any user, including system administrators.

requirements.text: Portal accounts unused for two years are deleted, with an email warning thirty days before deletion.
requirements.quote: Portal accounts that have not been used for two years shall be deleted, and the patient shall be warned by email thirty days before deletion.

requirements.text: Deleting a portal account does not affect the patient's PMS record.
requirements.quote: Deleting a portal account does not affect the patient's record in the PMS.

requirements.quote: The platform must be bought as a hosted service.

requirements.text: The platform must work with the e-lending supplier's lending service, which is provided under a separate contract and will not be replaced.
requirements.quote: the platform must work with that supplier's lending service but will not replace it.

requirements.text: A person can join if they live, work or study in Kestrel Vale, whatever their age.
requirements.quote: You can join the library if you live, work or study in Kestrel Vale, whatever your age.

requirements.text: Proof of address is not required for a child joining with a responsible adult who is already a member.
requirements.quote: Proof of address is not required for a child who joins with a responsible adult who is already a member.

requirements.text: Joining online should be complete in itself for anyone who can prove who they are online.
requirements.quote: Joining online should be complete in itself for anyone who can prove who they are online.

requirements.text: A person must be able to join online by giving name, date of birth, home address and at least one contact method (email or mobile number).
requirements.quote: You must be able to join online by giving your name, date of birth, home address and at least one way for the library to contact you, which is either an email address or a mobile phone number.

requirements.text: The platform checks the address against the council's address gazetteer and, if outside Kestrel Vale, asks whether the person works or studies there before they can continue.
requirements.quote: The platform shall check the address you give against the council's address gazetteer and, if the address is outside Kestrel Vale, shall ask whether you work or study in Kestrel Vale before you can continue.

requirements.text: When signing in with the council's customer identity service, name, date of birth and verified address are pre-filled and need not be proved again.
requirements.quote: If you sign in with the council's customer identity service, your name, date of birth and verified address will be filled in for you, and you will not be asked to prove them again.

requirements.text: Someone joining online without the identity service gets a digital card immediately for e-books, e-audiobooks and reserving, and can borrow physical items once staff have seen proof of identity and address.
requirements.quote: If you join online without the customer identity service, you will receive a digital card straight away that lets you borrow e-books and e-audiobooks and reserve items, and you will be able to borrow physical items once a member of staff has seen your proof of identity and address.

requirements.text: The platform shows next to each joining-form question why the information is needed and whether the question is optional.
requirements.quote: The platform shall show, next to each question on the joining form, why the library needs the information and whether the question is optional.

requirements.text: Equality monitoring questions are asked only after a person has joined, and answering is always optional.
requirements.quote: Equality monitoring questions, such as ethnicity and disability, are asked only after a person has joined, and answering them is always optional.

requirements.text: A welcome email or text with the card number is sent within five minutes of joining online.
requirements.quote: You will receive a welcome email or text message with your card number within five minutes of joining online.

requirements.text: Before creating a membership, the platform looks for existing members with the same name and date of birth or same email address and warns the person joining, and staff if present, of a possible duplicate.
requirements.quote: Before a new membership is created, the platform shall look for existing members with the same name and date of birth, or with the same email address, and shall warn the person joining, and the member of staff if there is one, that a duplicate may exist.

requirements.text: Branch staff must be able to register a new member on a single screen, scanning a new card and recording the proof of identity and address seen in the same visit.
requirements.quote: As a member of branch staff, you must be able to register a new member at the counter on a single screen, scanning a new card and recording the proof of identity and address you have seen in the same visit.

requirements.text: Staff must be able to print or show on screen a summary of the recorded information about a new member before they leave the counter.
requirements.quote: You must be able to print, or show on screen, a summary of the information recorded about a new member before they leave the counter.

requirements.text: New branch members are given a physical card at the counter, activated as soon as it is scanned against the new record.
requirements.quote: New members who join in a branch are given a physical card at the counter, and the card is activated as soon as it is scanned against the new record.

requirements.text: A photocard driving licence is accepted as proof of both identity and address.
requirements.quote: A photocard driving licence is accepted as proof of both identity and address.

requirements.text: A passport or national identity card is accepted as proof of identity only.
requirements.quote: A passport or national identity card is accepted as proof of identity only.

requirements.text: A utility bill, bank statement or council tax bill dated within the last three months is accepted as proof of address only.
requirements.quote: A utility bill, bank statement or council tax bill dated within the last three months is accepted as proof of address only.

requirements.text: A letter from a trusted referee is accepted as proof of both identity and address for a resident who has none of the other evidence.
requirements.quote: A letter from a trusted referee is accepted as proof of both identity and address for a resident who has none of the other evidence.

requirements.text: A student card from a school or college in Kestrel Vale is accepted as proof of identity for members aged 16 to 18.
requirements.quote: A student card from a school or college in Kestrel Vale is accepted as proof of identity for members aged 16 to 18.

requirements.text: The platform records which kind of evidence was seen and by whom, but does not store a copy of any document or any document number.
requirements.quote: The platform shall record which kind of evidence was seen and by whom, but shall not store a copy of any document or any document's number.

requirements.text: A branch supervisor may give a Restricted membership to a person who cannot provide any of the listed evidence.
requirements.quote: A person who cannot provide any of the evidence in the table may be given a Restricted membership by a branch supervisor.

requirements.text: A child under 16 can join only with the consent of a responsible adult, who is linked to the child's account at joining.
requirements.quote: A child under 16 can only join with the consent of a responsible adult, who is linked to the child's account when the child joins.

requirements.text: Up to two responsible adults can be linked to a child's account.
requirements.quote: Up to two responsible adults shall be linkable to a child's account.

requirements.text: A responsible adult can see their linked children's loans, reservations and due dates from their own account and renew the children's items.
requirements.quote: As a responsible adult, you will be able to see your linked children's loans, reservations and due dates from your own account, and to renew their items.

requirements.text: A child's account moves automatically to Teen on the 12th birthday and to Adult on the 18th birthday, and the member and any responsible adult are told a week beforehand.
requirements.quote: A child's account is moved to the Teen category automatically on the child's 12th birthday and to the Adult category on their 18th birthday, and the member and any responsible adult are told about the change a week before it happens.

requirements.text: The platform stops showing a child's loans to a responsible adult when the child turns 16, unless the child agrees to keep sharing them.
requirements.quote: The platform shall stop showing a child's loans to a responsible adult when the child turns 16, unless the child agrees to keep sharing them.

requirements.text: A visitor to Kestrel Vale can take out a Visitor membership that lasts three months and can be renewed once.
requirements.quote: If you are visiting Kestrel Vale, you can take out a Visitor membership that lasts three months and can be renewed once.

requirements.text: Visitor members have the entitlements set out in section 6 for their borrower category.
requirements.quote: Visitor members have the entitlements set out in section 6 for their borrower category.

requirements.text: A Visitor membership expires automatically at the end of its term and its holder is asked to return any items still on loan.
requirements.quote: A Visitor membership shall expire automatically at the end of its term, and its holder shall be asked to return any items still on loan.

requirements.text: Members can use either a physical card or a digital card on their phone; both carry the same card number and work at the counter, on kiosks and at extended-hours doors.
requirements.quote: You can use either a physical card or a digital card shown on your phone; both carry the same card number and both work at the counter, on kiosks and at extended-hours doors.

requirements.text: Members can add their digital card to their phone's wallet app.
requirements.quote: You will be able to add your digital card to your phone's wallet app.

requirements.text: A replacement physical card is free the first time in any twelve months; any further replacement in that period costs 2.50.
requirements.quote: A replacement physical card is issued at the counter free of charge the first time in any twelve months; any further replacement in the same twelve months costs 2.50.

requirements.text: When a replacement card is issued, the old card number is cancelled immediately so it can no longer be used to borrow or to enter an extended-hours branch.
requirements.quote: When a replacement card is issued, the platform shall cancel the old card number immediately so that it can no longer be used to borrow or to enter an extended-hours branch.

requirements.text: Members sign in to their account online with either the customer identity service or their card number and PIN.
requirements.quote: You will sign in to your account online with either the customer identity service or your card number and PIN.

requirements.text: PINs must be at least six digits, and the platform refuses a PIN that repeats one digit or is a simple sequence.
requirements.quote: PINs shall be at least six digits, and the platform shall refuse a PIN that repeats one digit or is a simple sequence.

requirements.text: Members can reset their own PIN using a link sent to their email address or a code sent to their mobile phone.
requirements.quote: You must be able to reset your PIN yourself, using a link sent to your email address or a code sent to your mobile phone.

requirements.text: After five failed sign-in attempts with card number and PIN, the platform locks the PIN for 30 minutes and tells the member by their preferred contact method.
requirements.quote: After five failed attempts to sign in with a card number and PIN, the platform shall lock the PIN for 30 minutes and tell the member by their preferred contact method.

requirements.text: Members borrowing at a kiosk are identified by scanning their card or typing their card number.
requirements.quote: Members borrowing at a kiosk are identified by scanning their card or by typing their card number.

requirements.text: Members can see on one page everything on loan with due dates, everything reserved with queue position, any charges owed and any blocks.
requirements.quote: You must be able to see, on one page, everything you have on loan with its due date, everything you have reserved with its place in the queue, any charges you owe and any blocks on your account.

requirements.text: Members who have chosen to keep a borrowing history can see a list of items they borrowed in the past.
requirements.quote: You will be able to see a list of the items you have borrowed in the past, if you have chosen to keep a borrowing history.

requirements.text: A borrowing history is kept only for members who choose to keep one, and the choice is off by default.
requirements.quote: A borrowing history is kept only for members who choose to keep one, and the choice is off by default.

requirements.text: Members can change their contact details, preferred pickup location and notification preferences at any time.
requirements.quote: You can change your contact details, your preferred pickup location and your notification preferences at any time.

requirements.text: A new email address or mobile number must be confirmed from that address or number before it is used.
requirements.quote: You will be asked to confirm a new email address or mobile number from that address or number before it is used.

requirements.text: The platform records every change to a member's details, who made it and when, and shows this history to branch staff.
requirements.quote: The platform shall record every change made to a member's details, who made it and when, and shall show this history to branch staff.

requirements.text: An adult membership is extended automatically each time the member borrows, renews or reserves an item.
requirements.quote: An adult membership is extended automatically each time the member borrows, renews or reserves an item.

requirements.text: The platform marks a membership inactive after three years without borrowing, renewing, reserving or signing in, and deletes the record six months later if the member has not responded to a reminder.
requirements.quote: The platform shall mark a membership as inactive when the member has not borrowed, renewed, reserved or signed in for three years, and shall delete the record six months later if the member has not responded to a reminder.

requirements.text: Members are reminded by their preferred contact method one month before their membership is closed for inactivity.
requirements.quote: You will be reminded by your preferred contact method one month before your membership is closed for inactivity.

requirements.text: Members can ask to close their membership at any time, online or in a branch, provided nothing is on loan and no replacement charges are owed.
requirements.section: 5.5 Closing an account and merging duplicates
requirements.quote: You can ask to close your membership at any time, online or in a branch, as long as you have nothing on loan and owe no replacement charges.

requirements.text: Branch supervisors can merge two records belonging to the same person, keeping the loans, reservations, charges and history of both under the card number the member chooses.
requirements.section: 5.5 Closing an account and merging duplicates
requirements.quote: As a branch supervisor, you must be able to merge two records that belong to the same person, keeping the loans, reservations, charges and history of both under the card number the member chooses.

requirements.text: Possible duplicate records found by the platform are listed for branch supervisors to review, and duplicates are resolved quickly once identified.
requirements.section: 5.5 Closing an account and merging duplicates
requirements.quote: Possible duplicate records found by the platform shall be listed for branch supervisors to review, and duplicates are to be resolved quickly once they have been identified.

requirements.text: Adult category is for members aged 18 and over.
requirements.quote: Adult, for members aged 18 and over.

requirements.text: Adult members may have up to 20 items on loan, no more than four of them DVDs.
requirements.quote: Adult members may have up to 20 items on loan at once, of which no more than four may be DVDs.

requirements.text: Adult members may have up to 15 reservations open.
requirements.quote: Adult members may have up to 15 reservations open at once.

requirements.text: Teen category is for members aged 12 to 17.
requirements.quote: Teen, for members aged 12 to 17.

requirements.text: Teen members may have up to 12 items on loan and 8 reservations open.
requirements.quote: Teen members may have up to 12 items on loan and 8 reservations open at once.

requirements.text: Teen members cannot borrow a DVD with an 18 certificate.
requirements.quote: Teen members cannot borrow a DVD with an 18 certificate.

requirements.text: Junior category is for members under 12.
requirements.quote: Junior, for members under 12.

requirements.text: Junior members may have up to 12 items on loan and 5 reservations, and may borrow only from children's and teenage collections and U or PG DVDs unless a responsible adult agrees otherwise.
requirements.quote: Junior members may have up to 12 items on loan and 5 reservations open at once, and may borrow only from the children's and teenage collections and DVDs with a U or PG certificate, unless a responsible adult has agreed otherwise.

requirements.text: Restricted category is for members who could not provide proof of identity and address.
requirements.quote: Restricted, for members who could not provide proof of identity and address.

requirements.text: Restricted members may have up to 3 items on loan, cannot borrow DVDs or equipment, and have the same e-lending and public computer access as Adult members.
requirements.quote: Restricted members may have up to 3 items on loan at once and cannot borrow DVDs or equipment, but they have the same access to e-lending and to the public computers as Adult members.

requirements.text: Home library service category is for members who receive deliveries.
requirements.quote: Home library service, for members who receive deliveries.

requirements.text: Home library service members may have up to 30 items on loan, each loan lasting until the next delivery.
requirements.quote: Home library service members may have up to 30 items on loan, and each of their loans lasts until the next delivery rather than for a fixed period.

requirements.text: Institutional category is for care homes, schools and nurseries.
requirements.quote: Institutional, for care homes, schools and nurseries.

requirements.text: Institutional members may have up to 60 items on loan for eight weeks. The platform shall record the named member of staff responsible for each institutional card.
requirements.quote: Institutional members may have up to 60 items on loan for a loan period of eight weeks, and the platform shall record the named member of staff responsible for each institutional card.

requirements.text: Entitlements of each category shall be configuration that stock and systems staff can change without supplier help, with each change recorded with who and when.
requirements.quote: The platform shall hold the entitlements of each borrower category as configuration that stock and systems staff can change without the supplier's help, and every change shall be recorded with who made it and when.

requirements.text: When a category's entitlements change, existing loans keep their due dates.
requirements.quote: When a category's entitlements change, existing loans keep the due dates they already have.

requirements.text: Members must be able to search by title, author, subject, series, ISBN and keyword, and filter by format, branch, age group, language and shelf availability.
requirements.quote: You must be able to search the catalogue by title, author, subject, series, ISBN and keyword, and to filter the results by format, branch, age group, language and whether a copy is on the shelf now.

requirements.text: For each title, show number of copies, holding branches, copies on the shelf and reservations waiting.
requirements.quote: You will see, for each title, how many copies the library has, which branches hold them, how many are on the shelf and how many reservations are waiting.

requirements.text: The platform shall load catalogue records from the stock acquisition system nightly and report records it could not load to stock and systems staff next morning.
requirements.quote: The platform shall load the catalogue records sent by the council's stock acquisition system each night, and shall report any record it could not load to stock and systems staff the next morning.

requirements.text: E-books and e-audiobooks appear in the same search results, marked as such, with availability fetched from the supplier at search time.
requirements.quote: E-books and e-audiobooks from the e-lending supplier shall appear in the same search results as physical items, marked as such, and their availability shall be fetched from the supplier's service at the time of the search.

requirements.text: Members can save a search and be told when a new title matches it.
requirements.quote: You can save a search and choose to be told when a new title matches it.

requirements.text: Members can make lists of titles, private or shared with anyone who has the link.
requirements.quote: You can make lists of titles, and keep each list private or share it with anyone who has the link.

requirements.text: Reference-only items are shown in search results but cannot be reserved or borrowed.
requirements.quote: Items that are for reference only, such as most of the local studies collection, are shown in search results but cannot be reserved or borrowed.

requirements.text: Council-owned kiosks are kept; the platform must drive them through the standard self-service protocol the current kiosks use.
requirements.quote: the platform must drive them through the standard self-service protocol that the current kiosks already use.

requirements.text: Members can borrow, return and renew at any kiosk in any branch and get a printed or emailed receipt listing due dates.
requirements.quote: You can borrow, return and renew items at any kiosk in any branch, and you will be given a receipt, printed or emailed as you choose, listing your due dates.

requirements.text: A kiosk shall refuse a loan exceeding entitlement or not allowed for the category and explain why in plain language.
requirements.quote: A kiosk shall refuse a loan that would take the member over their entitlement, or that the member's category does not allow, and shall tell the member why in plain language.

requirements.text: Kiosks shall be easy to use for older and first-time members.
requirements.quote: Kiosks shall be easy to use for older members and for members who have never used one before.

requirements.text: Kiosks shall accept contactless card payments where branch equipment allows.
requirements.quote: Kiosks shall accept contactless card payments where the branch's equipment allows.

requirements.text: If disconnected, a kiosk shall keep lending and returning offline for up to four hours and send transactions when reconnected.
requirements.quote: it shall continue to lend and return items offline for up to four hours, and shall send the transactions to the platform when the connection returns.

requirements.text: Staff must be able to lend by scanning card and items, and override an entitlement limit with a recorded reason.
requirements.quote: At the counter, you must be able to lend items to a member by scanning their card and the items, and to override an entitlement limit, recording your reason.

requirements.text: Entitlement overrides are reported to the branch supervisor each week.
requirements.quote: Overrides of entitlement limits are reported to the branch supervisor each week.

requirements.text: Staff must be able to lend to a member without a card after confirming identity by date of birth and address.
requirements.quote: You must be able to lend items to a member who has forgotten their card, once you have confirmed who they are by asking for their date of birth and address.

requirements.text: Books, audiobooks and music scores are lent for three weeks and can be renewed up to five times.
requirements.quote: Books, audiobooks and music scores are lent for three weeks and can be renewed up to five times.

requirements.text: High-demand titles are lent for one week and cannot be renewed.
requirements.quote: High-demand titles are lent for one week and cannot be renewed.

requirements.text: DVDs are lent for one week and can be renewed twice.
requirements.quote: DVDs are lent for one week and can be renewed twice.

requirements.text: Equipment is lent for two weeks, cannot be renewed and must be returned to the branch it was borrowed from.
requirements.quote: Equipment is lent for two weeks, cannot be renewed, and must be returned to the branch it was borrowed from.

requirements.text: No item shall fall due on a day its branch is closed; the due date moves to the next opening day.
requirements.quote: The platform shall set due dates so that no item falls due on a day when the branch it was borrowed from is closed; such a due date moves to that branch's next opening day.

requirements.text: Equipment can be borrowed only by Adult members who have held membership for at least three months.
requirements.quote: Equipment can be borrowed only by Adult members who have held their membership for at least three months.

requirements.text: Staff must ask the member to confirm they have read the safety guidance before lending equipment, and the platform records the confirmation.
requirements.quote: Before lending equipment, you must ask the member to confirm that they have read the safety guidance for it, and the platform shall record their confirmation.

requirements.text: The platform shall prevent loan of an item with an age certificate above the member's age unless a responsible adult has given permission.
requirements.quote: The platform shall prevent the loan of an item with an age certificate above the member's age, unless a responsible adult has given permission on the child's account.

requirements.text: Members can renew an item up to three times, online, by phone, at a kiosk or at the counter, if nobody else has reserved it.
requirements.quote: You can renew an item up to three times, online, by phone, at a kiosk or at the counter, as long as nobody else has reserved it.

requirements.text: Each renewal runs for the normal loan period from the day of renewal, not the old due date.
requirements.quote: Each renewal runs for the item's normal loan period from the day of the renewal, not from the old due date.

requirements.text: The platform shall automatically renew every eligible item two days before due and tell the member which were renewed, which not and why.
requirements.quote: The platform shall renew every eligible item on a member's account automatically two days before it is due, and shall tell the member which items were renewed, which were not, and why not.

requirements.text: When renewing several items, those that can be renewed are renewed even if others cannot.
requirements.quote: When you renew several items at once, the items that can be renewed will be renewed even if some of the others cannot.

requirements.text: Telephone renewals are handled by an automated line that recognises card number and PIN entered on the keypad.
requirements.quote: Renewals by telephone are handled by an automated line that recognises the card number and PIN entered on the phone's keypad.

requirements.text: Members can still renew while blocked, unless the block is for an item more than 28 days overdue.
requirements.quote: You will still be able to renew items while your account is blocked, unless the block is for an item that is more than 28 days overdue.

requirements.text: Members can reserve any borrowable title, whether or not a copy is on the shelf, and can choose any branch or mobile library stop as the pickup location.
requirements.quote: You can reserve any title that can be borrowed, whether or not a copy is on the shelf, and choose any branch or mobile library stop as your pickup location.

requirements.text: Reservations are free of charge for every member.
requirements.quote: Reservations are free of charge for every member.

requirements.text: The platform must not let a member reserve a title already on loan to them, or reserve the same title twice.
requirements.quote: The platform shall not let a member reserve a title they already have on loan, or reserve the same title twice.

requirements.text: Members can suspend a reservation for up to 90 days without losing their place in the queue.
requirements.quote: You can suspend a reservation for up to 90 days, for example while you are on holiday, without losing your place in the queue.

requirements.text: Reservations for a title are filled in the order placed, except that priority members' reservations go ahead of others.
requirements.section: 10.2 The queue and which copy is used
requirements.quote: Reservations for a title shall be filled in the order in which they were placed, except that reservations placed by priority members shall go ahead of other reservations.

requirements.text: When a copy is returned at any branch, the platform checks it against the reservation queue and tells staff or the kiosk whether it goes to the hold shelf or to another branch.
requirements.section: 10.2 The queue and which copy is used
requirements.quote: When a copy is returned at any branch, the platform shall check it against the queue of reservations and shall tell the member of staff or the kiosk whether the copy should go to the hold shelf or be sent to another branch.

requirements.text: When choosing a copy to fill a reservation, the platform prefers a copy at or nearest to the member's pickup location.
requirements.section: 10.2 The queue and which copy is used
requirements.quote: The platform shall prefer a copy at, or nearest to, the member's pickup location when choosing which copy fills a reservation.

requirements.text: Members are told promptly, by their preferred contact method, when a reserved item is ready to collect.
requirements.quote: You will be told promptly when an item you reserved is ready to collect, by your preferred contact method.

requirements.text: Reserved items are kept on the hold shelf for seven days, after which the reservation is cancelled and the item passes to the next member in the queue.
requirements.quote: Reserved items are kept on the hold shelf for seven days, after which the reservation is cancelled and the item passes to the next member in the queue.

requirements.text: Members receive a reminder two days before an uncollected reserved item is taken off the hold shelf.
requirements.quote: You will receive a reminder two days before a reserved item you have not collected is taken off the hold shelf.

requirements.text: Branch staff can print each morning a list of the reservations that have expired on their branch's hold shelf.
requirements.quote: You must be able to print a list each morning of the reservations that have expired on your branch's hold shelf, so that you can clear them.

requirements.text: Members with an extended-hours enrolment can collect reservations from the hold shelf during extended hours and borrow them on a kiosk.
requirements.quote: Members with an extended-hours enrolment can collect their reservations from the hold shelf during extended hours and borrow them on a kiosk.

requirements.text: An item needed for a reservation at another branch is sent on the next van run and arrives within three working days, unless that is operationally impractical.
requirements.quote: An item needed to fill a reservation at another branch shall be sent on the next van run and shall arrive within three working days, unless this is operationally impractical.

requirements.text: The platform shows every item in transit with its origin and destination branches and flags any item in transit for more than ten days.
requirements.quote: The platform shall show every item in transit, the branch it left and the branch it is going to, and shall flag any item that has been in transit for more than ten days.

requirements.text: When a branch is to close temporarily, a branch supervisor can move all its reservations to another pickup location in one action, giving affected members the standard notice period.
requirements.quote: When a branch is to close temporarily, as a branch supervisor you must be able to move all of its reservations to another pickup location in one action, giving the members affected the standard notice period.

requirements.text: Members can ask for a title the library does not hold to be borrowed from another library service, and are told within five working days whether the request is accepted.
requirements.quote: If the library does not hold a title, you can ask for it to be borrowed from another library service, and you will be told within five working days whether the request has been accepted.

requirements.text: Inter-library requests are limited to two at a time per Adult member and are not available to other borrower categories.
requirements.quote: Inter-library requests are limited to two at a time for each Adult member and are not available to other borrower categories.

requirements.text: The platform records the lending library, the return-by date and any conditions the lending library sets.
requirements.quote: The platform shall record the lending library, the date by which the item must be returned to it and any conditions it sets, such as use in the library only.

requirements.text: Members can return items to any branch, to either mobile library, or through the returns chute of any closed branch.
requirements.quote: You can return items to any branch, to either mobile library, or through the returns chute of any branch when it is closed.

requirements.text: Items returned through a chute while the branch is closed are treated as returned on the last day the branch was open.
requirements.quote: Items returned through a chute while the branch is closed are treated as returned on the last day the branch was open.

requirements.text: When an item with an attached note is returned, the platform shows the note to the person or kiosk returning it.
requirements.quote: When an item with a note attached is returned, for example a note recording a missing disc, the platform shall show the note to the person or kiosk returning it.

requirements.text: Members receive a reminder three days before an item is due, by email, text message or both as chosen.
requirements.quote: You will receive a reminder three days before an item is due, by email, text message or both, as you have chosen.

requirements.text: Overdue notices are sent by email or text message 7, 14 and 28 days after the due date.
requirements.quote: Overdue notices are sent by email or text message 7, 14 and 28 days after the due date.

requirements.text: Members with neither an email address nor a mobile number are sent the 28-day notice by post.
requirements.quote: Members who have neither an email address nor a mobile number are sent the 28-day notice by post.

requirements.text: After 42 days an item still on loan is marked as lost and the member is sent a bill for its replacement charge.
requirements.quote: After 42 days, an item still on loan shall be marked as lost, and the member shall be sent a bill for its replacement charge.

requirements.text: From go-live the library is fine-free for every member: no charge is made for returning any item late.
requirements.quote: From the day the new platform goes live, the library is fine-free for every member: no charge is made for returning any item late.

requirements.text: Overdue charges on members' accounts at the date of migration are written off.
requirements.quote: Overdue charges on members' accounts at the date of migration are written off.

requirements.text: The platform warns a volunteer selecting items for a home library member when an item has been lent to that member before.

requirements.quote: You can apply for an extended-hours enrolment if you are an Adult member and have held your membership for at least a month, by attending a short induction at the branch.

requirements.text: The platform keeps for 30 days a record of each entry to an extended-hours branch received from the building management system.
requirements.quote: The platform shall keep, for 30 days, a record of each entry to an extended-hours branch received from the building management system.

requirements.text: Members can book a public computer at any branch up to seven days ahead, online or at the counter, for up to two hours a day.
requirements.quote: You can book a public computer at any branch up to seven days ahead, online or at the counter, for up to two hours a day.

requirements.text: Members sign in to a public computer with card number and PIN.
requirements.quote: You will sign in to a public computer with your card number and PIN.

requirements.text: Non-member visitors are given a one-hour guest pass by staff, with no personal details recorded.
requirements.quote: Visitors who are not members are given a one-hour guest pass by staff, and no personal details are recorded for it.

requirements.text: Junior sessions use the filtered internet profile; Teen and Adult sessions use the standard profile.
requirements.quote: Junior members' sessions shall use the filtered internet profile, and Teen and Adult members' sessions shall use the standard profile.

requirements.text: The platform releases a booked computer to walk-in users if the member has not signed in within ten minutes of the booking start.
requirements.quote: The platform shall release a booked computer to walk-in users if the member who booked it has not signed in within ten minutes of the start of the booking.

requirements.text: Printing is charged by the page to the member's account, and a print job is released only when the member pays at the print station or a kiosk.
requirements.quote: Printing from the public computers is charged by the page to the member's account, and a print job is released only when the member pays at the print station or a kiosk.

requirements.text: Members can choose to receive notices by email, text, both, or by post if they have neither an email address nor a mobile number.
requirements.quote: You can choose to receive notices by email, by text message, by both, or by post if you have neither an email address nor a mobile number.

requirements.text: Members can choose which kinds of message they receive, except overdue notices and bills, which are always sent.
requirements.quote: You can choose which kinds of message you receive, apart from overdue notices and bills, which are always sent.

requirements.text: Every message is sent from the library's own email address and telephone number, and a text message never contains more about a loan than its title and due date.
requirements.quote: The platform shall send every message from the library's own email address and telephone number, and a text message shall never contain more about a loan than its title and due date.

requirements.text: Members aged 13 and over can join online without a responsible adult and choose their own contact details and notification preferences.
requirements.quote: Members aged 13 and over can join online without a responsible adult, and can choose their own contact details and notification preferences.

requirements.text: Newsletters and event announcements are sent only to opted-in members, and each carries an opt-out link.
requirements.quote: Newsletters and event announcements are sent only to members who have opted in to them, and every one carries a link to opt out.

requirements.text: Stock and systems staff must be able to edit the wording of every notice and preview it before use.
requirements.quote: you must be able to edit the wording of every notice the platform sends and preview it before it is used.

requirements.text: The platform records every notice sent, with date, channel and delivery status, and shows this record to branch staff.
requirements.quote: The platform shall record every notice sent to a member, with its date, its channel and whether it was delivered, and shall show this record to branch staff.

requirements.text: The platform gives each staff member a role that sets what they can see and do, and stock and systems staff can create and change roles without the supplier's help.
requirements.quote: The platform shall give each member of staff a role that sets what they can see and do, and stock and systems staff shall be able to create and change roles without the supplier's help.

requirements.text: Staff sign in with the council's single sign-on, and a staff account is disabled automatically when the person leaves the council.
requirements.quote: Staff sign in with the council's single sign-on, and a staff account is disabled automatically when the person leaves the council.

requirements.text: The platform records every time staff view a member's record, and Information Governance officers can see who viewed a given record and when.
requirements.quote: The platform shall record every time a member of staff views a member's record, and Information Governance officers shall be able to see who viewed a given record and when.

requirements.text: Branch staff see only the details they need; date of birth and address are hidden until the member of staff chooses to show them, and showing them is recorded.
requirements.quote: their date of birth and address are hidden until you choose to show them, and showing them is recorded.

requirements.text: Staff can record each branch's opening hours and planned closures up to eighteen months ahead, and the platform uses them to set due dates.
requirements.quote: You must be able to record each branch's opening hours and planned closures, such as bank holidays, up to eighteen months ahead, and the platform shall use them to set due dates.

requirements.text: Staff can record an unexpected branch closure on the day, and items due at that branch on closed days have their due dates moved to its next opening day.
requirements.quote: you must be able to record the closure on the day, and items due back at that branch on the days it is closed shall have their due dates moved to its next opening day.

requirements.text: Stock and systems staff can move groups of items between branches for stock rotation, and the platform updates each item's home branch on arrival.
requirements.quote: Stock and systems staff shall be able to move groups of items between branches as part of stock rotation, and the platform shall update each item's home branch when it arrives.

requirements.text: Items not borrowed for two years are listed each quarter for their branch to consider withdrawing.
requirements.quote: Items that have not been borrowed for two years are listed each quarter for their branch to consider withdrawing them.

requirements.text: The platform tells the stock acquisition system about each item's withdrawal so its catalogue record can be updated.
requirements.quote: The platform shall tell the council's stock acquisition system about the withdrawal of each item, so that its catalogue record can be updated.

requirements.text: The platform produces the Libraries Board's quarterly report without manual work, showing active members, new members, loans, renewals, reservations and computer sessions by branch, borrower category and ward.
requirements.quote: The platform shall produce the Libraries Board's quarterly report without manual work, showing active members, new members, loans, renewals, reservations and computer sessions, each by branch, by borrower category and by ward.

requirements.text: Reports for library managers are available in near real time.
requirements.quote: Reports for library managers shall be available in near real time.

requirements.text: Library managers can build their own report from platform data, filter it and export it as a spreadsheet.
requirements.quote: As a library manager, you must be able to build your own report from the platform's data, filter it and export it as a spreadsheet.

requirements.text: Figures for the national annual statistics return are produced from the platform using the return's own definitions.
requirements.quote: Figures for the national annual statistics return are produced from the platform using the return's own definitions.

requirements.text: No report shows a member's name, card number or address unless the user's role allows it, and a ward report suppresses any figure below five.
requirements.quote: No report shall show a member's name, card number or address unless the user's role allows it, and a report by ward shall suppress any figure below five.

requirements.text: Members' personal information is held only in UK data centres.
requirements.quote: The platform shall hold members' personal information only in data centres in the UK.

requirements.text: A member's record is deleted 18 months after last activity unless items are on loan or charges are owed.
requirements.quote: A member's record shall be deleted 18 months after the member's last activity, unless the member still has items on loan or owes charges.

requirements.text: The link between a returned loan and its borrower is removed once the item is returned and any charge paid, except for members who keep a borrowing history.
requirements.quote: The link between a returned loan and the member who borrowed it shall be removed once the item has been returned and any charge paid, except for members who keep a borrowing history.

requirements.text: Members can ask for a copy of their information, and Information Governance officers can produce it from the platform in a single export.
requirements.quote: You can ask for a copy of the information the library holds about you, and Information Governance officers must be able to produce it from the platform in a single export.

requirements.text: A member can ask for borrowing history to be deleted at any time and it is deleted within one working day.
requirements.quote: You can ask for your borrowing history to be deleted at any time, and it will be deleted within one working day.

requirements.text: Equality monitoring answers are kept apart from the member's record and used only in reports in which no member can be identified.
requirements.quote: Answers to equality monitoring questions are kept apart from the member's record and are used only in reports in which no member can be identified.

requirements.text: Every member-facing page meets WCAG 2.2 level AA.
requirements.quote: Every page that members use shall meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines version 2.2 at level AA.

requirements.text: Members can use the whole account, catalogue and joining form with a screen reader and with the keyboard alone.
requirements.quote: You will be able to use the whole of your account, the catalogue and the joining form with a screen reader, and with the keyboard alone.

requirements.text: Kiosks provide audio guidance and a large-text mode that a member can switch on at the start of a session.
requirements.quote: Kiosks are given audio guidance and a large-text mode, which a member can switch on at the start of a session.

requirements.text: Members can ask for notices in large print or another format, and the choice is remembered for future notices.
requirements.quote: You can ask for any notice to be sent to you in large print or another format, and your choice will be remembered for every future notice.

requirements.text: The platform is tested for accessibility by disabled users, including listening-session participants, before go-live.
requirements.quote: The platform shall be tested for accessibility by disabled users, including members who took part in the listening sessions, before it goes live.

requirements.text: Member-facing pages are available 99.5 per cent of each month, outside agreed maintenance windows.
requirements.quote: The pages that members use shall be available 99.5 per cent of the time in each month, outside maintenance windows agreed with the council.

requirements.text: 95 per cent of catalogue searches return results within two seconds.
requirements.quote: 95 per cent of catalogue searches shall return results within two seconds.

requirements.quote: The platform shall support 2,000 members signed in at once and 300 loans or returns a minute across all branches, kiosks and mobile libraries.

requirements.text: Maintenance causing unavailability is done outside branch opening hours, with members told at least three days ahead.

requirements.text: All data is backed up daily and the platform can be restored to within one hour before a failure.

requirements.text: PINs are stored only in a form that cannot be read back.

requirements.text: Members do not re-register or choose a new PIN; existing card numbers and PINs continue to work.
